verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports event-triggered automation. Godot automatically imports files placed in the project folder, and import plugins let you define custom handling for those import events. Editor plugins written in GDScript can extend editor behavior, but EditorScript runs manually via File > Run rather than on events. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an event/rule system (e.g., signals or editor event hooks), declarative rule definition for automated triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation workflows.
